name: Starship Tracker
tagline: A fan-run Starship launch desk that stays quiet until the status truly moves
description: It watches public information about the next Starship flight and stays quiet while nothing moves, so an alert means something changed. A live countdown board separates official confirmations from fan guesses and streaming chatter. Public sources only, with rumor labeled as rumor.
